# dtcloud_regions (Data Source)

Lists the regions available to the account.

The region a resource is created in comes from the provider's `region_id`, not from here; this is how to discover the valid values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dtcloud_regions" "all" {}

output "region_ids" {
  value = data.dtcloud_regions.all.ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ids` (List of Number) Just the ids.
- `regions` (List of Object) The regions visible to the caller. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))
